name: crosstabs
description: Build auditable survey crosstabs and run 39 statistical tools locally from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable survey crosstabs and statistical tests
interface.longDescription: Analyze categorical and survey data in Codex with a local Crosstabs MCP server. The plugin provides 39 numerical tools, two evidence resources, and a research workflow that keeps assumptions, bases, effect sizes, limitations, and provenance visible. It does not claim full parity with the browser workspace; unsupported project, weighting, reporting, coding, and wave-management workflows are identified explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this survey file and build evidence-linked crosstabs.
Choose the right test for this contingency table and explain assumptions.
Audit these crosstabs for sparse cells, effect size, and multiple testing.
